name: GL_TRANSLATION_TRACKING
description: GL_TRANSLATION_TRACKING contains information about foreign currency translation history. Each row stores the range of periods for which translation has been performed for each balancing segment value in each ledger. The EARLIEST_EVER columns store the earliest accounting period that has ever been translated for a given balancing segment value in a given ledger. The EARLIEST_NEVER columns store the earliest accounting period (following the EARLIEST_EVER period) that has never been translated for a given balancing segment value in a given ledger.

columns.name: BAL_SEG_VALUE
columns.description: Segment value whose balances are translated.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Accounting books defining column.

columns.name: TARGET_CURRENCY
columns.description: Target currency that translates the balances.

columns.name: EARLIEST_EVER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the earliest ever translated period.

columns.name: EARLIEST_EVER_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number of the earliest ever translated period.

columns.name: EARLIEST_EVER_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Year of the earliest ever translated period.

columns.name: EARLIEST_NEVER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the earliest never translated period.

columns.name: EARLIEST_NEVER_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number of the earliest never translated period.

columns.name: EARLIEST_NEVER_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Year of the earliest never translated period.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TARGET_BUDGET_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Target budget version defining column.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FLAG
columns.description: Transaction balance type (Actual or Budget).

columns.name: AVERAGE_TRANSLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Translate average balances flag.

columns.name: FIRST_OUTDATED_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of earliest period with obsolete translation records.

columns.name: FIRST_OUTDATED_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number of earliest period with obsolete translation records.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
